4123794.name: Chabad of Morgan Hill & North S. Jose
4123794.note: Lubavitch.com, Nov 8 2018, 'Chabad Opens in Morgan Hill': 'Morgan Hill will be welcoming a new Chabad presence in December', Rabbi Mendel and Chani (née Dalfin) Liberow. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 16575 San Ramon Drive, Apt. A, Morgan Hill (Nov 2019); it is now at 16430 Monterey Highway, Morgan Hill, so it moved there after Nov 2019 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 16575 San Ramon Drive, Apt. A, Morgan Hill (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Nov 13 2019)

4376620.name: Chabad Center for Jewish Life
4376620.note: California Secretary of State record (via BizProfile): 'Chabad Center For Jewish Life ... 2218 Chanticleer Lane, Santa Cruz ... Filing date 5/2/2019. Entity type Nonprofit Religious Corporation.' The corporation's filing, not a report of its opening, so medium. Its chabad.org listing was published May 7 2019 and therebbesimpact.com has the center from 2019 (Rabbi Menachem and Mushka Geisinsky; she is a daughter of Chabad by the Sea's Friedmans); Cause IQ's 2020 is its IRS record. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 2219 Juan Pablo Lane, Santa Cruz (Dec 2019, Aug 2020); it is now at 2218 Chanticleer Lane, Santa Cruz, so it moved there after Aug 2020 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 2219 Juan Pablo Lane, Santa Cruz (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Dec 13 2019 to Aug 8 2020)

4438650.name: Chabad of Hollywood - Jewish Community Center
4438650.note: The center's own page: Rabbi Zalman and Chaya Partouche moved to Hollywood to establish it, 'one of 43 new Chabad institutions in California opened after ... Rabbi Tzemach Cunin OBM passed away' (July 2019); the listing number (4438650) is from late 2019. Chabad.org News (2023) says they moved to the neighborhood 'five years ago'. Checked (Nov 6): no independent second source found. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 7000 Franklin Avenue, Hollywood (Dec 2019); it is now at 7095 Hollywood Boulevard, Suite 319, Hollywood, so it moved there after Dec 2019 (when, not found). In 2019 the listing was named Chabad of Hollywood.

earlier.where: 7000 Franklin Avenue, Hollywood (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Dec 15 2019)

4182118.name: Bais Nochum
4182118.note: No year found. Its About page: founded by the late Rabbi Mendel and Mira Labkowsky, who married in 1980 and were later sent to Los Angeles. therebbesimpact.com: 2013; the listing number (4182118) is from late 2018. Its chabad.org listing went up on Oct 31 2018 (chabad.org's own record), so it existed by then. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 151 South Detroit Street, Los Angeles (Aug 2019); it is now at 8750 West Pico Boulevard, Los Angeles, so it moved there after Aug 2019 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 151 South Detroit Street, Los Angeles (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Aug 25 2019)
